name: 11753 · Jericho, NY
findings: ZIP 11753 (Jericho) has 143 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11753 (Jericho) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
46% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11753 (Jericho) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 65% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
